name: hgi_qdq_lg_r2-lgr2-COMMIT
purpose: Native-audit successor of the closed LG v6 group (launch 270.7 ps on 227 wq_o pins: ONE register per bit between the W input and E output faces 64.8 um apart cannot sit at both pins). r2 = capture register at the input pin + launch register at the output pin per bit; the face-to-face crossing becomes a whole-cycle reg->reg path. Same die slot quant_NW0_lg 64.8 x 194.4 and die-granted pins; +1 edge per direction (rq, rr, wq), priced in the exact QUANT bench (LG=2: RL+4, WC+2).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_qdq_lg_port_group_r2 #(.BANKS(2)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/qw/static/ot_hgi_qdq_transport_r2.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: QDQ_LG_exact
bench.cmd: IO_REGS=1 LG=2 TSPLIT=2 bash tools/hgi_unit_tput/run_qdq_static.sh {RUN}/bench_lg && cat {RUN}/bench_lg/m0.log

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_lg_r2/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_lg_r2/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_lg_r2 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_qdq_lg_port_group_r2  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
